meta.audience: people who plan their day on a phone
meta.title: 한 점 플래너
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (한 점 플래너, a day planner that starts from a single dot (fictional app)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 한 점 플래너, a day planner that starts from a single dot (fictional app)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: One shape on warm paper #F5F3EE: ink #16161A and one coral #FF5A3C, swapped as the shape changes role; warm grey #8A867E for small text.
rationale.type: Pretendard ExtraBold for labels and the line, set under the shape so it stays the hero; white inside the shape where it is a button.
rationale.motion: One shape that never cuts: each scene springs it from the previous state (a dot, a pill button, a checkbox, a loader ring, a switch, a calendar card, a bar chart) with overshoot, so it stretches past its target and settles; secondary details (a press, a check drawing on, a knob, dates, a counter) land on the beat; the last frame is the first, so the reel loops.
rationale.sound: Bright pop at 128 BPM in C major with a recorded marimba (VCSL, CC0) on the arpeggios and as Mickey-mousing: every change of shape lands a marimba note one scale step higher than the last.
rationale.visuals: All code: every state is an outline resampled to 240 points with one winding; the next outline is cyclically shifted to the alignment that moves points least, then interpolated with a damped spring; motion blur samples the fast springs.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: the shape carries it.
